entries.title: The Weight of Distance
entries.roomRationale: Distance becomes a mapped experience of routes, impedance and choice, with The Road as the primary interpretive room.

entries.title: The Last Blank Spaces
entries.roomRationale: Blankness is treated as a claim about the Earth and its knowability, supported by archival survival and graphic convention.

entries.title: Why North Is Up
entries.roomRationale: Orientation is a convention of the map that also stages cosmology and learned habits as apparently natural.

entries.title: The Problem of Scale
entries.roomRationale: Scale is a formal map operation whose effects change with the geographic and urban objects selected for representation.

entries.title: The Soul of Places
entries.roomRationale: The essay asks how mapped land acquires character, then tests that character against urban experience and documentary memory.

entries.title: Frontiers Are Not Borders
entries.roomRationale: The Border supplies the central distinction between a moving zone and a fixed line, while Earth and Road reveal its spatial consequences.

entries.title: The Invention of the Homeland
entries.roomRationale: Homeland is examined as a bounded political image staged through national myth and stabilized through repeated documents.

entries.title: Invisible Maps of Disease
entries.roomRationale: Disease moves through routes and contacts, becoming visible through urban records and retrospective archival reconstruction.

entries.title: Ruins as Documents
entries.roomRationale: Ruins are read as an unstable archive embedded in land and city fabric rather than as transparent remnants of a single past.

entries.title: The Geography of Memory
entries.roomRationale: Memory is located through civic sites and routes, with archival traces exposing how those locations are selected and revised.

entries.title: Myth as Cartography
entries.roomRationale: Myth is treated as a performed spatial order that gives the Earth a legible structure through map-like narrative choices.

entries.title: Naming as Cartography
entries.roomRationale: Naming is a cartographic operation that selects places, fixes identities and participates in civic and territorial authority.
